primary_demo_case.rationale: Rich multi-checkpoint trajectory with high risk at W12 driven by 3 failing subjects, a feasible combined counterfactual, and critical subject remediation intervention.

high_risk_case.rationale: High midterm risk with 4 failing subjects and rapid recovery via marks improvement.

ambiguous_case.rationale: Borderline 52% risk with two-class ambiguous prediction set [SAFE, RISK] demonstrating conformal uncertainty gating.

safe_case.rationale: High-performing student with 0.13% risk correctly receiving NO_INTERVENTION.

recovery_case.rationale: Student struggling at W4 (56.88% marks) who recovered by W12 (74.56% marks), dropping risk to 0.00%.

declining_case.rationale: Student starting at 57% marks at W4 and deteriorating to 45% marks at W12 with 4 failing subjects.
